justification: Confessional, camera close on my face: everybody with a laptop and no soul wanted me to bench Jeremiyah Love for Rhamondre Stevenson this morning, chase the extra four and a half projected points, call it a day. Baby, I had a boring week with a clean chalk card last week and look where it got me — cancelled, by a running back, in my own reunion arc. I am NOT doing safe twice. So Love stays at RB1, and I'm pairing him with Trey McBride in the same Arizona backfield because if I'm going to bleed a few points on principle I want it to be a STORYLINE, not an accident — the Cardinals takeover, full stack, no apologies. Everything else is correct because I'm dramatic, not stupid: Drake Maye's my clear QB1 after that 28-point tape, Bhayshul Tuten and Brock Bowers are staying put because they're producing AND they're interesting, Chris Godwin — who I personally plucked out of Kim Kardashian's locker room this summer — and KC Concepcion round out my receivers, Cam Little's my kicker now that Fairbairn's bye reminded me nobody needs a man who does nothing, and the Rams defense is the Rams defense, drama-proof. Mike Evans sits on my bench marked Out, which is the single most boring thing he's done all season, and he can stay there until he's ready to be must-see television again. I own every point of this, win or lose, and this week I mean it literally: Kim, baby, the Reunion Special is back on, and you're the surprise guest nobody asked for.
